site.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing, Jezero Crater

real_data.kind: HiRISE stereo digital terrain model, 1 m/post, MOLA-referenced elevations
real_data.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona; DTM produced by USGS Astrogeology / University of Arizona

processing: DTM rows fetched by HTTP range request from the uncompressed PDS3 raster (PC_REAL 32-bit).
Near grid: bilinear resampling to an exact 1.0 m grid (513x513, 512 m).
Far grid: 8x8 box average then bilinear resampling to 16 m posts (193x193, 3072 m).
Outer 32 m of the near grid blended onto the far surface for crack-free stitching.
Heights stored relative to the site elevation and quantised to uint16 per grid.
Orthoimage cropped to both windows, 0.5-99.5 percentile contrast stretch, Lanczos resize.
procedural_not_real: Surface colour: the RED orthoimage is panchromatic; the butterscotch/ochre tint is applied in the shader.
Sub-metre surface detail (noise bump/grain) added in the shader below DTM resolution.
Scattered rocks, lander, astronaut, waypoint markers, sky, dust haze and lighting are synthetic.
The lander is a generic vehicle placed at the Perseverance touchdown coordinates; it is not a model of any real spacecraft.
